newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade active at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade active at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet in Kansas until noon, then turned active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady with last week.

Inquiry good, demand light early, good later. Sales confirmed on 25400 slaughter steers and 15100 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 60000 head confirmed including 20600 head or about 35 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00; pen Select with end Choice 1275 lbs 63.50; pen Select and Choice 1350 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Dressed basis Few Select with end Choice 1200-1250 lbs 104.00.
Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1020-1150 lbs 64.00; pen Select with Choice 1025 lbs 63.50.
week to date: 60,000 last week: 63,900 last year: 46,700
